Hello!
Thanks for your interest in contributing to mockblocks.

mockblocks is a fork of [scratchblocks](https://github.com/scratchblocks/scratchblocks). It is not maintained by the Scratch Team, and changes here are not sent back upstream.

---

When **reporting an issue**, please do the following:

* Read [the **syntax guide**](https://en.scratch-wiki.info/wiki/Block_Plugin/Syntax) (the base syntax is the same as scratchblocks)
* Use **code examples**, where relevant
* Provide **screenshots**, where relevant

---

For **pull requests**:

* When developing, you need to run a local web server:

    ```
    npm start
    ```

* Browse to <http://localhost:8000/> to access the development version.
